title: Multi-Generational Family Smiling at Baby Outdoors, 1940s Snapshot Photo
description: A charming three-generation family portrait taken outside beside a shingled house wall with a window and garden trellis. A young father smiles warmly as he holds up a joyful, laughing baby boy. Beside them stand the baby's grandparents: the grandfather dressed formally in a three-piece suit holding a walking cane, and the grandmother wearing round spectacles and an apron-front dress, gazing affectionately at the child. The back shows heavy black album mounting residue at the corners.
